lines: Itna na baras ke woh aa na sake, jab woh aa jaayen to jam ke baras
couplets.en: Hold back the rain until my beloved arrives, then let it pour.

lines: Itna baras ke woh ja na sake
couplets.en: Let it rain so hard my beloved has to stay.

lines: Is qadar tera tasavvur kabhi kabhi barh jaata hai
couplets.en: Sometimes the thought of you grows until it fills my mind.

lines: Teri soorat nigaahon mein phirti rahe
couplets.en: Your face keeps passing before my eyes.

lines: Ishq tera sataaye to main kya karoon, haaye main kya karoon
couplets.en: What am I to do when loving you gives me no peace?

lines: Maine tinke nasheman ke bahaaron se dhoondhe

lines: Aur ek ek se dil ko samjha liya hua tha
